ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_ONE: I'm Kevin, an aspiring Fullstack Developer with a strong interest in web development, backend technologies and IT infrastructure.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_TWO: I enjoy turning ideas into working applications, understanding how things work under the hood and solving problems along the way. From HTML, CSS and TypeScript to Angular, servers and self-hosted systems, I like exploring the full picture of modern IT.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_THREE: I'm constantly learning, experimenting and building — with the goal of becoming a developer who doesn't just write code, but understands the systems behind it.

PRIVACY.FORM_TEXT: When you use the contact form, your name, email address and message are processed and sent by email to kevinpomian@icloud.com through this website's PHP script. Your email address is used as the reply address.
PRIVACY.FORM_PURPOSE: The details are used to receive and respond to your enquiry. Please do not submit sensitive information that is not needed to handle your enquiry.
PRIVACY.LEGAL_BASIS_TEXT: Where an enquiry relates to entering into or performing a contract, processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other enquiries may be processed on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding).

PRIVACY.RETENTION_TEXT: The PHP script does not permanently store enquiries on this website; it passes them to the mail system. Retention in the email inbox and by the hosting provider still needs to be clarified and stated before publication.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_TEXT: Subject to legal requirements, you have rights to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, as well as the right to object to processing. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. Contact the email address above to exercise your rights.
